title: uac_auth Module
content_markdown:
UAC AUTH (User Agent Client Authentication) module provides a common API for building authentication headers.

It also provides a common set of authentication credetials to be used by other modules.

Note that authentication provided by this module supports both qop "auth" and qop "auth-int" but if both values are presented by the server, "auth" will be prefered.
overview:
UAC AUTH (User Agent Client Authentication) module provides a common API for building authentication headers.

It also provides a common set of authentication credetials to be used by other modules.

Note that authentication provided by this module supports both qop "auth" and qop "auth-int" but if both values are presented by the server, "auth" will be prefered.

exported_parameters.name: credential
exported_parameters.description: Contains a multiple definition of credentials used to perform authentication.
exported_parameters.notes:
NOTE that the password can be provided as a plain text password or as a precalculated HA1 as a hexa (lower case) string (of 32 chars) prefixed with "0x" (so a total of 34 chars).

This parameter is required if UAC authentication is used.

exported_parameters.name: auth_realm_avp
exported_parameters.description: The definition of an AVP that might contain the realm to be used to perform authentication.
exported_parameters.notes: If you define it, you also need to define “auth_username_avp” and “auth_password_avp”.

exported_parameters.name: auth_username_avp
exported_parameters.description: The definition of an AVP that might contain the username to be used to perform authentication.
exported_parameters.notes: If you define it, you also need to define “auth_realm_avp” and “auth_password_avp”.

exported_parameters.name: auth_password_avp
exported_parameters.description: The definition of an AVP that might contain the password to be used to perform authentication. The password can be provided as a plain text password or as a precalculated HA1 as a hexa (lower case) string (of 32 chars) prefixed with "0x" (so a total of 34 chars) (for example "0xc17ba8157756f263d07e158504204629")
exported_parameters.notes: If you define it, you also need to define “auth_realm_avp” and “auth_username_avp”.
